patch_description: Add a bounded three-GPU ejection-chain neighborhood. When a high-pressure model cannot fit on a desirable target because of memory fragmentation, the algorithm can first eject one model from that target to a low-pressure third GPU, then move the bottleneck model into the newly available target space. The complete two-move action is evaluated atomically using the resulting KVPR profile, so it is accepted only when it improves the maximum-pressure objective. Candidate limits keep this repair operator inexpensive.
